title: AC1021 tablet strict conversion after WCS mesh extrusion default fix

source.provenanceLimit: Local user corpus; producer and repository provenance are unauthenticated. The source is not committed.

finding.previousStop: Strict export refused one model-space WCS POLYLINE mesh because DRW_Polyline::parseDwg assigned the zero-initialized temporary extrusion (0,0,0), although DWG POLYLINE 3D/MESH/PFACE bodies omit extrusion.
finding.normativeLayout: ODA Open Design Specification v5.4.1 §§20.4.17, 20.4.33, 20.4.34: 3D POLYLINE, PFACE, and MESH bodies contain no extrusion field. The DXF/public default is (0,0,1).
finding.implementation: Initialize the parsed extrusion to (0,0,1); the 2D POLYLINE branch still overwrites it from its encoded extrusion field.
